# fct_subscription_transactions

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_subscription_transactions` · dbt area: `subscriptions`

Advisor subscription charges tracked through balance transactions for charges/payments and refunds. Filtered to succeeded transactions only. Each row is one balance transaction with gross/net/fee amounts in USD, subscription product and billing frequency, and customer-to-advisor matching via email. Sourced from Stripe.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | The user ID of the advisor tied to that Stripe Customer ID, matched using their email in Portal with their Stripe Customer Email  >> SOURCE - Stripe & Portal |
| `balance_transaction_description` | A text string attached to the transaction object, for internal use. Often taken from the Charge Description >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `balance_transaction_id` | Unique identifier for the balance transaction, and primary key for this table. >> SOURCE - Stripe data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `balance_transaction_reporting_category` | Groupings of transactions types based on how they show in Stripe's reporting >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `balance_transaction_type` | The type of transaction, such as 'charge' or 'refund'. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `charge_description` | A text string attached to the Charge object describing what it was for (often the Subscription Description) >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `charge_id` | The id of the charge or refund charge associated with the balance transaction >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `charge_status` | The status of the Charge, such as 'suceeded' >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `created_at` | When the transaction took place. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `customer_email` | The customer’s (aka advisor's) email address. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `customer_name` | The customer’s (aka advisor's) name. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `fee_amount_usd` | Fees paid by Fora to Stripe for this transaction, in USD. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `gross_amount_usd` | Gross amount of the transaction (what the advisor paid Fora), in USD (NOT their local currency). >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `invoice_id` | The ID of the invoice this record is a part of. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `invoice_number` | The number of the invoice associated with this record. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `net_amount_usd` | Net amount of the transaction, in USD. Gross amount minus fees, refunds, and disputes. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `refund_reason` | Reason for the refund, either user-provided (duplicate, fraudulent, or requested_by_customer) or generated by Stripe internally (expired_uncaptured_charge). >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `stripe_customer_id` | The customer associated with the balance transaction (based on charge or refund details) >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `subscription_billing_frequency` | The billing frequency (Annual, Monthly, etc.) of the subscription product tried to the invoice. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `subscription_description` | A text string describing what the Subscription plan is, based on the Subscription associated with the Invoice. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `subscription_id` | The ID of the subscription for the Invoice associated with this record. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
| `subscription_product_name` | The name of the Product associated with the Subscription for the Invoice. >> SOURCE - Stripe |
